Items.Title: Welcome To Project KONGOR
Items.Subtitle: a community keeping Newerth alive
Items.Body:
Project KONGOR is a community-driven effort to keep the real Heroes Of Newerth alive.

The game client, the match servers, and the services behind them are open source, and anyone can help.

Visit The Project On GitHub

Items.Title: Join The Community On Discord
Items.Subtitle: find matches and the latest news
Items.Body:
Connect with other players, find matches, and get the latest news.

Join The Discord Server

Items.Title: Patch Notes
Items.Subtitle: what changed this week
Items.Body:
This week's update polishes the home page and the way news reaches you.

  • Message of the day: news now appears in a carousel, and each card opens a full article.
  • Announcement board: announcements now come and go on their own schedule.
  • Links: a link in the in-game browser now opens in your own browser.

As always, thank you for playing.

Items.Title: Weekend Event
Items.Subtitle: double experience, Saturday and Sunday
Items.Body:
Every match played this weekend gives double experience, from Saturday morning until Sunday night.

Bring your friends, try a new hero, and make the most of it.

Items.Title: Community Tournament
Items.Subtitle: sign-ups open on Discord
Items.Body:
A community tournament is coming, open to teams of every skill level.

Find a team, sign up on Discord, and watch this space for the date.
